name: SCARF
aliases: Scalable Continual Learning Framework for Memory-efficient Multiple Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A framework for memory-efficient continual learning across multiple 3D scenes that factorizes NeRF MLP weights into scene-specific and cross-scene shared components, generating parameters via a hypernetwork.
summary: SCARF is a memory-efficient continual learning method for multiple 3D scenes that factorizes NeRF weights into shared and scene-specific components to prevent catastrophic forgetting.
